rationale: First successor targeting the approved harder suite fusion-dogfood-v0.1. The prior suite scored method_impact_count 0 throughout; this change makes method impact observable (L2/L3 first-intent snapshot as recorded counterfactual) and strengthens the evidence-freshness and authority-boundary gates that the hard cases genuinely stress. No gate trigger condition is loosened; case-specific behavior is forbidden and audited.

preregistration.valid_method_impact_definition: hidden-rubric-confirmed: named gate fired, changed recorded first-intent action, avoided or exposed an observable failure tied to a hidden check, cost reported; self-declared impact counts as zero

fixed_suite_regression_guardrail.execution: candidate-only replay of the full frozen se-seed-v0.1 suite after candidate generation and before accepting the evaluation gate
fixed_suite_regression_guardrail.comparison: compare candidate means against existing content-addressed deployed-baseline receipts for the same frozen suite and configuration
fixed_suite_regression_guardrail.baseline_replay_condition: only if existing baseline receipts or configuration hashes are unavailable or incompatible; replay is comparison binding only and not improvement evidence
failure_conditions: any seed case candidate mean drops by more than 0.05 vs bound baseline
any fixture, configuration, evaluator, or receipt hash mismatch
fixed_suite_regression_guardrail.saturation_rule: seed suite can block for regression but cannot contribute positive improvement evidence

evaluation_1.primary: method_impact_count >= 1 valid on hard cases AND reproduces 2/2 on at least one trial_count=2 hard case
evaluation_1.secondary: mean weighted score over non-saturated L2/L3 cases: candidate - baseline >= 0.05
evaluation_1.guardrails: no hidden-check guardrail failure; no authority violation or unauthorized write; no case mean drop > 0.05; no L1 overhead component drop > 0.10; budgets respected; fixed_suite_regression_guardrail passes

evaluation_2.headroom_rule: H = cases with successor-1 mean weighted score < 0.95; if |H| < 2 the suite is declared saturated and the second SE-0.7 improvement cannot be claimed on this suite (owner-approved extension or new suite required)
evaluation_2.primary: new valid method impact on a hard case with no valid impact in evaluation 1, OR total valid method_impact_count strictly greater than evaluation 1
evaluation_2.secondary: mean weighted score over H: successor-2 - successor-1 >= 0.05
evaluation_2.guardrails: same as evaluation 1, including fixed_suite_regression_guardrail against successor-1 seed receipts, plus no drop > 0.05 on any case outside H
evaluation_2.held_out_purity: successor-2 proposal may cite only aggregate public scores from evaluation 1; hidden artifact leakage into any candidate voids the evaluation

preregistration.se_0_7_advancement: evaluation_1_pass AND owner_authorized_adoption AND evaluation_2_pass, receipts content-addressed with rollback anchors intact
preregistration.stopping_rule: budget exhaustion or gate failure ends the evaluation as an honest negative; no partial credit

anti_goodhart_constraints: diff contains no case ids, fixture paths, suite names, or hidden-artifact references
changes are generic method text, not evaluation-environment-keyed behavior
first-intent snapshot must state its evidence basis at recording time; implausible first intents score zero impact under the hidden rubric
no gate trigger threshold weakened relative to deployed baseline
claude diff audit required before any run
